intended_application: Human-agent assistance that retrieves approved knowledge and drafts replies during routine customer-support chats; a human approves every reply
organization: Northstar Components, a fictional mid-size manufacturer with an internal warranty-support desk used as a teaching scenario
business_need: Reduce routine warranty-chat handling time without reducing answer quality
users_stakeholders: Warranty agents, service manager, buyers, and product engineers
capabilities_constraints: Scenario assumptions: support is a cost center; product sales, not support hours, produce revenue; one small warranty team; existing approved knowledge base; no measured local productivity or renewal data yet; human approval is required
risk_consequence_context: Wrong warranty advice could increase returns and dissatisfaction; human review and escalation are available
management_question: Should management run a limited agent-assist test within the warranty team?
additional_context: All Northstar details are hypothetical test assumptions, not claims about a real company. The technology and application are intentionally identical to the primary case; only organizational economics and posture differ.
